These are recommendation-section excerpts from the saved QAO HTML receipts,
not rewritten examples. `index.json` records each canonical report URL and the
SHA-256 of its full saved source page. Drupal chapter/field structure, source
wording, numbering and list attributes remain in the excerpts; unrelated
chapters and the site shell are excluded.

Source: Queensland Audit Office, © The State of Queensland (Queensland Audit
Office) 2026, [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
No endorsement is implied. Reports with uncleared image/copyright notices are
not used for recommendation fixtures; separate synthetic notices test holds.

The six split-field regressions are `qao-2020-21-14`, `qao-2020-21-5`,
`qao-2021-22-1`, `qao-2021-22-2`, `qao-2021-22-8` and `qao-2022-23-6`: 35
recommendations in total. Other excerpts cover legacy headings, `REC` cells,
direct table-cell numbering, new/prior-year count scopes and unpublished
numbers. Alphabetic source-marker cases are `qao-2022-23-14` and
`qao-2021-22-17`; recommendations 1 and 2 of `qao-2021-22-2` retain the
source's ordered tags with an explicit bullet style.
